description: Alberta Oil Spills 1975-2013 is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. Source data is from the Energy Resources Conservation Board (ERCB). This file shows all releases reported to the ERCB between January 1, 1975 and February 4, 2013. There are three entries before 1975, but in this database anyway, reporting seems unreliable before then. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Environmental Services. The table has 70 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2021-06-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
